projects.step1Desc: This is your project dashboard. All your business analysis projects live here.
projects.step2Desc: Click here to start a new business analysis project. Give it a name and begin working.
projects.step3Desc: Each row is a project. Click the project name to open it and start analyzing.
projects.step4Desc: Use this menu to rename or delete a project.
projects.step5Desc: Configure your AI provider keys here. BAWS uses them to power AI analysis.

conversations.step6Desc: This sidebar lists all conversations in your project. Each conversation is a separate analysis session.
conversations.step7Desc: Click here to create a new conversation and start chatting with AI agents.
conversations.step8Desc: Upload project documents (PDF, DOCX, etc.) here. AI will use them as context for analysis.
conversations.step9Desc: Click one of these presets (e.g. 'Write User Stories') to quickly start a common BA task.
conversations.step10Desc: Type your message here. Use / for quick commands and @ to mention a specific AI agent.
